name: Empty 3D scene
description: Camera, light and ground. Start from scratch.

name: Physics playground
description: Boxes and balls falling onto the ground.

name: Roll-a-ball: Coin collector
description: Roll the ball around and collect spinning coins.

name: 3D Platformer
description: Run and jump with an animated hero, grab the coins, reach the flag.

name: 2D Platformer
description: Side-on platformer: run, jump gaps, stomp the slime, reach the flag.

name: Endless runner
description: Swipe between lanes, jump over crates, grab coins. How far can you get?

name: Arena shooter
description: Dodge waves of slimes while your hero shoots the nearest one. Survive as long as you can!

name: Hill explorer
description: Find the gems on rolling hills while a hunter chases you around the trees.

name: First person
description: Walk and look around an arena in first person, jump onto the blocks and collect every coin.

name: Kart racing
description: Race 3 laps around an oval against the clock. Beat your best lap!

name: Cars and boats
description: Walk up to a car or a boat, press A to get in, and drive it. Enter / Exit vehicle seat you; you pass the joystick on yourself.
